transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... I know this might sound a little hard to explain, but I've been completely convinced lately that one of my MBA classmates and a startup advisor are quietly coordinating opportunities for me. 

It's like... certain comments they make in class, or specific Slack messages, feel like they're actually coded signals about where my career is supposed to go. It's been taking up a lot of my headspace, so I figured I should probably talk to someone about it.
About how long ago did you first start noticing these coded signals?

I'd say... it's been going on for about two months now. It started right around the time I began the part-time MBA prerequisite program. I'm still keeping my regular operations job while taking the classes, so... yeah, it was right around when that whole schedule started that I first picked up on it.
Aside from noticing these messages, have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?

Yeah, actually, I have. Um... I'd say it happens a few times a week. It's usually when I'm working late, either on school stuff or operations plans for my job. 

I'll hear my name, or sometimes just a short phrase like "go now." It sounds so clear that I actually stop and check my phone, or look around the room to see who said it, but... yeah, there's never anyone there.
During these past two months, have you felt unusually energized, euphoric, or irritable, like your mood was abnormally high?

Yeah, I have. Most days I've felt unusually switched on, like really optimistic. It just feels like I'm right on the edge of something huge happening for me. But at the same time, I've noticed I'm getting irritated a lot easier. Like, I'll snap at my teammates at work, or at my boyfriend, over really small delays that normally wouldn't bother me at all. It's just a lot of energy, I guess.
Have you ever experienced these coded signals or voices during times when your mood and energy felt completely normal?

No, I haven't. Before this whole stretch of being so energized and driven, I never had messages feel coded like this, or heard my name when no one was there. None of that happened when I was just feeling normal. Those experiences really only started once my mood and my workload intensity shifted, right after I began the MBA prerequisites.
Before these past two months, have you ever had a period lasting two weeks or more where you felt deeply depressed, hopeless, or lost interest in almost everything?

No, not really. I mean, I've had normal bad days or gotten stressed out with work, but... no, I've never had a period like that where I felt deeply depressed or just lost interest in everything for weeks. I've always been pretty driven and steady before all this recent stuff started.
Have you been using any recreational drugs, prescription medications, or energy supplements since starting this busy schedule?

No, I haven't. I mean, I drink coffee, but that's about it. I don't use any recreational drugs, and I'm not taking any prescription medications or weird energy supplements or anything like that. Just my normal routine, honestly.
Have you recently had any new medical problems, head injuries, or physical health conditions?
No, nothing like that. I've been physically fine. I haven't hit my head or had any new medical issues pop up at all. Physically, everything has been completely normal.
